adjudication.rationale: In `app/assets/javascripts/discourse/models/group.js`, `findMembers()` issues an async `Discourse.ajax(...).then(...)` and unconditionally `setProperties({ user_count, limit, offset, members })` from the response. In `admin-group.js.es6`, the `next`/`previous` actions update `group.offset` and immediately call `group.findMembers()`; there is no request cancelation or sequencing. If a user clicks next/previous rapidly, multiple requests can be in-flight and a slower, earlier response can resolve after a later one and overwrite `offset`/`members` with stale page data (`result.meta.offset`), causing the UI to show the wrong page.
